answer: Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 335 answers need 335 separate inference runs with separate seeds. Because the wander index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the garden audit republishes the full set. Reusing one run across aliases collides on the hollow identifier and voids the later submissions, which means the operator burns for 335 runs and collects one. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
